trust.title: Show our quality or process
trust.description: Make the product or service feel credible by showing how care, expertise, or standards appear in the work.
trust.assistantPrompt: Focus on quality signals, process details, and evidence that makes the brand feel credible.

trust.title: Introduce the founder or expert perspective
trust.description: Use a human expert voice so customers understand who is behind the brand and why they should trust it.
trust.assistantPrompt: Center the founder, practitioner, or expert so the post feels human, informed, and trustworthy.

trust.title: Share customer proof
trust.description: Translate social proof into a clean post that shows real outcomes or believable customer experiences.
trust.assistantPrompt: Create a post anchored in customer proof, testimony, or review-like reassurance.

trust.title: Communicate what our brand stands for
trust.description: Clarify the promise, standards, or values the brand wants to be known for.
trust.assistantPrompt: Show the brand promise clearly so viewers understand its point of view and standards.

awareness.title: Introduce the brand personality
awareness.description: Create a first impression post that quickly teaches the mood, aesthetic, and voice of the brand.
awareness.assistantPrompt: Prioritize memorable brand personality and visual identity over detailed product explanation.

awareness.title: Join a timely conversation
awareness.description: Use a relevant seasonal or cultural hook to make the brand feel current and easy to notice.
awareness.assistantPrompt: Tie the brand to a timely conversation while still keeping the visual language on brand.

awareness.title: Show the product experience visually
awareness.description: Let people imagine what it feels like to encounter or use the brand for the first time.
awareness.assistantPrompt: Make the experience of the product or service instantly legible and attractive.

awareness.title: Create a memorable first-impression post
awareness.description: Package the brand as a clear, high-impact introduction someone can understand in a few seconds.
awareness.assistantPrompt: Design for recognition and first-impression clarity more than depth.

educate.title: Explain how our offer works
educate.description: Break down the product, service, or process in a way a first-time viewer can understand quickly.
educate.assistantPrompt: Use clear visual explanation so viewers understand what the offer is and how it works.

educate.title: Explain why we are different
educate.description: Clarify the unique value, ingredients, method, or expertise that makes the brand distinct.
educate.assistantPrompt: Turn differentiation into something understandable, not just a claim.

educate.title: Answer a common customer question
educate.description: Use the post to address confusion, hesitation, or a recurring product question.
educate.assistantPrompt: Treat the post like an answer to a real customer question or objection.

educate.title: Teach the best use case
educate.description: Show when, how, or for whom the product or service is most useful.
educate.assistantPrompt: Focus on practical guidance that helps people imagine the right use case.

engagement.title: Start a low-effort conversation
engagement.description: Use a simple opinion prompt, comparison, or visual question to invite interaction.
engagement.assistantPrompt: Create something people can react to quickly without needing deep context.

engagement.title: Tell a personal or behind-the-scenes story
engagement.description: Make the brand feel easier to relate to through a human anecdote or process moment.
engagement.assistantPrompt: Lean into human relatability and a conversational tone rather than polished selling.

engagement.title: Invite the audience into the brand world
engagement.description: Ask for reactions, preferences, or participation so the brand feels more social and open.
engagement.assistantPrompt: Prompt audience participation and make engagement feel welcome and easy.

engagement.title: Create a playful moment around the brand
engagement.description: Use humor, a quick challenge, or a light prompt to make the brand feel active and approachable.
engagement.assistantPrompt: Favor approachable, reactive energy over polish-heavy messaging.

sales.title: Highlight the offer clearly
sales.description: Present the product, service, or promotion so viewers can understand the value and next step immediately.
sales.assistantPrompt: Make the offer legible, concrete, and easy to act on.

sales.title: Explain why this is worth buying
sales.description: Support conversion with clear reasons, quality cues, or benefit framing.
sales.assistantPrompt: Balance desirability and practical justification so the post supports buying decisions.

sales.title: Show the result or experience
sales.description: Help the audience imagine the payoff, transformation, or end state they want.
sales.assistantPrompt: Center the outcome people want rather than only the product itself.

sales.title: Answer a common buying objection
sales.description: Use the post to reduce hesitation around price, trust, effort, or fit.
sales.assistantPrompt: Address a real barrier to purchase and make the answer feel calm and credible.

community.title: Spotlight a customer or community member
community.description: Celebrate real people so the brand feels relational and not purely transactional.
community.assistantPrompt: Make the post feel like community recognition rather than self-promotion.

community.title: Reinforce the values people join for
community.description: Show what people identify with when they stay connected to the brand over time.
community.assistantPrompt: Emphasize shared values and emotional loyalty cues.

community.title: Create a recurring ritual or series
community.description: Frame the post as part of a repeatable format that customers can look forward to.
community.assistantPrompt: Design the post like part of an ongoing brand ritual or familiar series.

community.title: Invite customer input and feedback
community.description: Make the audience feel heard by explicitly asking for preferences, stories, or reactions.
community.assistantPrompt: Use the post to deepen the relationship through feedback and participation.
